label: Escape the Imperial Dungeon
objectives: Navigate the subterranean cells beneath the Imperial City.
Reach the Shift Gate and escape into the open wilderness.
context_injection: The player is trapped in the Imperial Dungeon beneath the Imperial City, imprisoned by the usurper Jagar Tharn. Ria Silmane's spirit has provided guidance to the Shift Gate. Escaping this dark facility is the absolute priority.

label: Travel to Hammerfell
objectives: Rest in the wilderness or an inn to receive Ria Silmane's guidance.
Journey to Hammerfell and investigate the location of Fang Lair in Rihad.
Uncover the path or directions leading to the dwarven ruins of Fang Lair.
context_injection: Having escaped the dungeon, the player receives visions from Ria guiding them to Hammerfell. They must seek information in Rihad to locate the lost dwarven ruins of Fang Lair and begin recovering the eight fragments of the Staff of Chaos.

label: Retrieve Fragment from Fang Lair
objectives: Journey to Fang Lair in the Dragontail Mountains of Hammerfell.
Brave the subterranean dwarven depths and recover the first fragment of the Staff of Chaos.
context_injection: The player has reached Fang Lair in Hammerfell. They must brave its ancient traps and guardians to claim the first fragment of the Staff of Chaos.

label: Retrieve Fragment from Labyrinthian
objectives: Travel north to the frozen province of Skyrim.
Brave the ancient nordic maze of Labyrinthian and secure the second fragment.
context_injection: Guided by Ria Silmane, the player travels to the frozen ruins of Labyrinthian in Skyrim to secure the second piece of the Staff of Chaos.

label: Retrieve Fragment from Elden Grove
objectives: Journey to the lush forests of Valenwood.
Locate the sacred sanctuary of Elden Grove and claim the third fragment.
context_injection: The quest continues into the magical heart of Valenwood at Elden Grove to retrieve the third fragment hidden within the sacred grove.

label: Retrieve Fragment from Halls of Colossus
objectives: Travel to the arid desert province of Elsweyr.
Infiltrate the colossal desert temple and secure the fourth fragment.
context_injection: The player explores the massive desert temple known as the Halls of Colossus in Elsweyr to find the fourth fragment.

label: Retrieve Fragment from Crystal Tower
objectives: Cross the seas to the ancestral homeland of Summerset Isle.
Ascend the magical Crystal Tower and recover the fifth fragment.
context_injection: The pristine Crystal Tower of Summerset Isle holds the fifth fragment. The player must ascend the guarded spire to claim it.

label: Retrieve Fragment from Crypt of Hearts
objectives: Journey northwest to High Rock.
Descend into the haunted Crypt of Hearts and recover the sixth fragment.
context_injection: A perilous path leads to the Crypt of Hearts in High Rock to recover the sixth fragment among ancient subterranean tombs.

label: Retrieve Fragment from Murkwood
objectives: Venture deep into the treacherous swamps of Black Marsh.
Find the ever-shifting dark forest of Murkwood and claim the seventh fragment.
context_injection: Deep within the swamps of Black Marsh lies the living grove of Murkwood holding the seventh fragment of the Staff.

label: Retrieve Fragment from Dagoth Ur
objectives: Travel east to the volcanic ashen lands of Morrowind.
Ascend the slopes of Red Mountain to Dagoth Ur and claim the final fragment.
context_injection: The final piece of the Staff is located in the volcanic caldera of Dagoth Ur in Morrowind. Securing it allows the Staff to be fully reassembled.

label: Return to Cyrodiil
objectives: Reassemble the eight fragments into the complete Staff of Chaos.
Journey back to Cyrodiil to challenge the usurper Jagar Tharn.
context_injection: With all eight fragments collected and the Staff assembled, the player returns to Cyrodiil for the final confrontation.

label: Enter the Imperial Palace
objectives: Breach the Imperial Palace in the Imperial City.
Fight through Tharn's elite guards and wards to reach the inner sanctum.
context_injection: The player has breached the Imperial Palace to confront Jagar Tharn.

label: Confront Jagar Tharn
objectives: Confront the Imperial Battlemage Jagar Tharn.
Unleash the Staff of Chaos to defeat the usurper and rescue Emperor Uriel Septim VII.
context_injection: The final battle against Jagar Tharn. Using the Staff of Chaos will break the illusion and restore Emperor Uriel Septim VII to the Ruby Throne.
